name: LA CONFERENCE EPISCOPALE NATIONAL DU CAMEROUN

grants.description: The proposed Consolidating Systems and Services for the Management of Orphans and Vulnerable Children (OVC) in Cameroon (CoSMO) is a five-year project to be implemented across 68 health districts nationwide beginning on or around January 2023. The CoSMO Project seeks to improve overall well-being am

Amplify the contributions of women as active agents in peacebuilding and resilience efforts, and ensure their meaningful inclusion in decision-making processes in six communities of the Southwest and Northwest Regions.
